text:
alex_choi: Heads-up — seeing a latency regression on Mixtral-large in prod after yesterday's kernel selector tweak. p50 up ~2.2x for long-context requests. Repro locally on dedicated pool.

maria_g: Ugh. Any profiler output or stack traces?

alex_choi: Pasted a short profiler capture from a 1k token chat run (dev env, dedicated). Strange mix of kernels and a big jump in KV handling time.

```text
PROFILER SNAPSHOT 1768504321
model: mixtral-large-v1
seq_len: 1024
active_kernel: flash_attn_2 (fallback to attn_v2 on some layers)
per_layer_attn_ms: [0.9, 1.1, 0.8, 5.6, 6.2, 5.9, ...]
kv_cache_total_ms: 52.3ms -> (baseline 18.7ms)
kv_cache_miss_rate: 0.29
num_key_value_heads: 8
kv_dim: 128
paged_frag_ratio: 0.41
queued_batch_size: 1.9 -> 3.8 (autoscaler heuristics bumped batching)
```

cheng_li: The big hints are: (1) kv_cache_total increased, (2) paged fragmentation high, (3) batching heuristics bumped queued batch size. Could be a poor kernel pick that doesn't play nice with our paged KV layout + MQA/GQA mapping.

sasha_p: Did we change RoPE scaling or head mapping for Mixtral recently? RoPE scale mismatch can shift attention kernel behaviour and affect KV packing.

alex_choi: We did flip a RoPE normalization tweak in the model-profile step (scale_factor 0.875 -> 1.0) when onboarding Mixtral. That might change the runtime memory access pattern.

maria_g: Quick experiments I ran: forcing kernel to attn_v2 on the heavy layers reduced attn latency but KV ops stayed high. Forcing flash_attn_2 everywhere made kernel latencies stable but raised memory pressure -> more paged KV evictions.

cheng_li: Suggestion: try increasing num_key_value_heads to 16 for bench (so per-head kv_dim halves if kv_dim fixed) and also lower page_size/compaction threshold. In bench I saw throughput recover when num_kv_heads=16 for Mixtral-like head dims.

alex_choi: microbench results I just ran, mixed context 512/1024:

```text
CONFIG A (num_kv_heads=8, kv_dim=128, page_size=16k) -> throughput 412 req/s, p50_token_ms 9.8
CONFIG B (num_kv_heads=16, kv_dim=64, page_size=8k, compaction_threshold=0.25) -> throughput 478 req/s, p50_token_ms 7.6 (+16%)
frag_ratio A: 0.38, B: 0.18
KV_miss_rate A: 0.21, B: 0.07
```

maria_g: Nice. That suggests fragmentation is the main culprit: larger per-head kv dims make paged layout more likely to fragment under our current allocator, and the kernel selector ends up choosing kernels that exacerbate memory movement.

cheng_li: Also check kernel selection policy: we currently pick kernel based on aggregate FLOPs and peak memory. For MQA/GQA models with asymmetric head dims, we should prefer kernels that stream KV into contiguous pages or that support partial head packing. Propose adding a heuristic: if paged_frag_ratio > 0.2 and model_kind in {mixtral,mistral} then prefer attn_v2_streaming kernel.

sasha_p: I'll prototype a small change to the selector and a canary rollout. Also will add a metric for per-request paged_frag_ratio so we don't only look at aggregate.

alex_choi: Quick config I want to try across canary: set num_key_value_heads override to 16 for Mixtral-large on dedicated, lower max_batch_ms from 12 -> 6, and compaction_threshold 0.25. Prep A/B: control is current prod.

```json
{
  "overrides": {
    "mixtral-large-v1": {
      "num_key_value_heads": 16,
      "max_batch_ms": 6,
      "compaction_threshold": 0.25
    }
  },
  "kernel_selector": {
    "heuristics": ["avoid_flash_on_high_frag", "prefer_streaming_on_mqa"]
  }
}
```

runtime-bot: Started canary rollout: mixtral-large-v1 override -> 2% traffic (canary id c-1768504321). Monitor: latency, p50_token_ms, kv_miss_rate, paged_frag_ratio.

ci-bot: Perf test queued: bench-suite/mixtral-longctx (runs in ~14m).

maria_g: I'll watch canary metrics and run a deeper perf trace if we see regression. If positive, schedule a gradual ramp to 50% and push selector heuristic.

alex_choi: Thanks. Next action: sasha will send a short PR with selector heuristic + metric, cheng will run a 24h bench with num_kv_heads 16 vs 8, maria will monitor canary.

sasha_p: On it. tagging @cheng_li and @maria_g. :thumbsup:

alex_choi: One more note — Qwen family previously tolerated larger per-head dims because RoPE mapping there spreads accesses differently; don't assume one tuning fits all model families. We'll keep per-model overrides.

maria_g: Agreed. Let's capture these as a small runbook item so support can react faster next time.

alex_choi: Created a short doc stub in runbooks/kv-frag-mixtral.md (will flesh after bench).

sasha_p: Canary metrics look promising after 25m: p50_token_ms down ~18% vs control, kv_miss_rate down ~65%. Continuing ramp.
